calendar_clarification: All UTC March rows are intentionally excluded. This removes March31 UTC opening bars of the Apr1 Globex session. Because incomplete sessions are excluded, momentum-family final omits Apr1 as well as the known Apr3 shortened session; nine complete reserved sessions remain. Do not compute April signals or outcomes before a joint frozen winner.
projection_rule: selection natural count ×36/27. This is a projection, never an observed final count. Prior rejected families retain their original disclosed projection; no winning selection changes.
